New message in #sales:

sarah: @lobu what's our pipeline total this month?

input.text: Hi Sarah — I don't have access to query the pipeline data from here. Could someone on the team pull the current-month pipeline total (from the CRM/dashboard) and share it, or let me know what source you'd like me to use? Happy to help once I can get to the right data.

content.text: I replied to Sarah letting her know I can't access the pipeline data directly from this channel and asked the team to share it or point me to the right source.
